main_text.p: pede, manu, voce, viribus omnibus: & de execratione quoque ait addidisse. Sed nec pauca de actionibus his Æschinis, & concilio ipso Amphictyonico, habet Demosthenes in oratione ea, qua se & Ctesiphontem contra calumnias adversarii tuetur, ac nequissima ejus consilia, linguam Philippo in perniciem patriæ commodantis, trahit in lucem. Quæ adscribere heic, supervacaneum, locum monstrasse lectori, satis.
main_text.head: DE STATU & REPUBLICA MASSILIENSIUM.
main_text.p: MASSILIA perantiqua urbs, & non parum olim fortunata, in litore Galliæ ad mare mediterraneum posita, origine Græca, à profugis ex Ionia Phocæensibus dominatum Persarum aversantibus inter barbaros Salyas condita, cum Cyrus rerum in Asia potiretur. Hæc inter infesta vicinorum arma, quibus ab initio fere assiduis premebatur, vix tenues res suas tuens ac defensans pau-latim tamen crevit, & bellis frequen-tibus[?] exercitata, armorumque peritior facta.

page.notes: Faint marginal fragments at the right edge (around the lines "quibus", "pau-", "frequen-") are show-through or the adjoining page and are not transcribed. Line-end word "frequen-" has an unclear letter after "frequen"; read as "frequentibus" with [?]. Bottom-right speckles and fragments are not printed text. Long s normalised to s; Æ, æ, Græca, Ionia, Phocæensibus, Massilia spelled as printed. The top paragraph continues from the previous page.
